figurative_meaning_en: continuously; without stopping; all the time; round the clock
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে চব্বিশ ঘণ্টা কাজ করে যায়।
example_sentences_in_english: It's been raining non-stop for 24 hours.
note: This idiom reflects the modern concept of a full day, commonly used in contemporary Bengali speech.
